correction_policy: Challenges are corrected publicly within 24 hours or the verdict is withdrawn. Every verdict carries the exact declaration digest assessed and the quoted span that produced it, so any target can re-derive or dispute it with the reproduce command.

provenance.method: Public registry index read over HTTPS with cursor pagination. No target server was contacted, probed, or invoked.

publication_state: DRAFT — contains unreviewed candidate findings. Not publishable. Every finding must be confirmed or rejected by a human reading the declaration before this edition may be published.
scope_limit: Every verdict in this edition is a statement about a declaration as published to the public MCP registry on the stated date. No target was contacted, probed, or invoked. Registry-declaration signal is strictly weaker than a tool-level scan: a target whose runtime does require human approval, but whose published declaration does not say so, is recorded as DECLARATION_SILENT and that sentence remains true.
